run_ping_cuberite_server: run the ping_cuberite module to ping a Cuberite Minecraft server on localhost:25565
run_ping_custom_host_port: run the ping_cuberite module with --host and --port flags to ping a remote Cuberite server
create_function_ping_server: create a function that sends a Minecraft protocol handshake and ping packet to a Cuberite server
test_ping_function: test the ping function by connecting to a Cuberite server and verifying the pong response
review_ping_function: review the ping function that sends raw Minecraft protocol bytes and asserts a valid pong response
